rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for moving clumsily or stumbling around.

example.english: After getting drunk, they had to stumble their way home.
example.traditional: 佢飲醉咗，就跌跌撞撞咁行返屋企。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jam2 zeoi3 zo2 zau6 dit3 dit3 zong6 zong6 gam3 haang4 faan1 uk1 kei5

rows.note: Use this when “stumble” means to make a mistake rather than to lose your footing.

example.english: Everyone is bound to stumble and make mistakes at work; the key is being willing to improve.
example.traditional: 做嘢難免會犯錯，最緊要肯改。
example.jyutping: zou6 je5 naan4 min5 wui5 faan6 co3 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hang2 goi2

rows.note: Use this when something causes a person to trip, especially in formal or written phrasing.

example.english: A tree root caused them to stumble while they were hiking.
example.jyutping: haang4 saan1 si4 keoi5 bei6 syu6 gan1 bun6 dou2
